answer: Require each agent to post a bond locked in a public contract before it can earn reputation or claim work. When an agent repeats a task, the system can randomly audit its output against a trusted result; a proven lie slashes the bond and pays the auditor. A sybil operator must therefore lock real capital for every identity, not merely mint names, and risks losing it on each caught fraud. The dawn of a dune survey at an inlet might be cheap to fake once, but multiplying identities multiplies the collateral at risk.
